method.label: Express the numbers using one unknown

annotationRationale: The verbal relationships produce a linear equation in one unknown. Solving an equation with parentheses supports the model, and absolute value gives the requested difference.
sourceMethod: Follows the official substitution into an equation for the second number, writing the other two numbers in terms of it from the start.

review.mathCheck: Substitution gives \(8b-280=96\), hence \(b=47\), third number 7, and first number 42. These satisfy all three conditions, and \(|42-47|=5\), choice E.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA 2022 AMC 10A Problem 3 on attached page 3. Direct substitution into the sum is equivalent to the official intermediate equation involving b and c.
review.annotationCheck: The modeling and absolute-value assessment, with parenthesized-equation solving as support, fits the explanation. No pedagogically material step is missing.
